   \[

   \]

   \[
   600 \times 700 = 420000
   \]
   \[
   600 \times 9 = 5400
   \]
   \[
   30 \times 700 = 21000
   \]
   \[
   30 \times 9 = 270
   \]

5. Add all the results together:
   \[
   420000 + 5400 + 21000 + 270 = 447070
   \]

So, the final answer is \(\boxed{447070}\).
